description: Whether a PDF's first page with text carries the article's title (#532, #541; the apps' port #546). Read by tests/test_pdf_title_check.py, Packages/BioMedLit PDFTitleCheckContractTests and Android PdfTitleCheckContractTest. A case gives the text of the page read and the title as stored; outcome is matches or mismatch (with share, the share of the title's adjacent word pairs, in the title's order, that the page also has, to 6 decimals), or no_title, no_text, translated_title (no share). The rules: text is NFKC-normalised, a soft hyphen (U+00AD) dropped, then fully case-folded (Python's str.casefold: ß and ẞ are ss, a final sigma is sigma, a dotless ı stays dotless, an Old Cyrillic variant form is its letter; the apps' foldings agree with it on every letter and number, measured); a word is a run of letters and numbers (Unicode L and N, by Python's table: a private-use code point is none; an underscore, a hyphen, punctuation and a combining mark separate words). The page is read twice, once with a word hyphenated over a line break joined (a letter or number, an ASCII hyphen, U+2010 or U+00AD, spaces or tabs, an optional CR, LF, any whitespace, a letter or number) and once as it is; a pair found in either reading counts. A stored title's markup (an element's tag: < or </, an ASCII letter, letters, numbers, _ : -, optional attributes after whitespace, optional /, >; never a bare < or >) is read as a word break and as nothing, and the better reading counts. A one-word title counts that word. The title's pairs are counted as a list (a pair the title repeats counts each time), the page's as a set. no_title: neither reading of the title has a word. no_text: the page has no word. matches when share >= min_pair_share; a mismatch whose title, markup removed, has words that joined with nothing between run to at least min_joined_characters letters and numbers, and appear so in the page's words joined the same way, matches with share 1 (the title carried whole, word breaks ignored, #546); otherwise a mismatch whose title, markup removed and trimmed, is one square-bracketed whole (which may hold bracketed parts one level deep), with at most a full stop after, is translated_title. Only mismatch refuses a PDF. Every case is asserted on all three platforms: add a row here, not a test on one platform.
